decisions.boundary_condition: Treat this as a soft preference because the evidence ranges from tentative interest to a direct requirement.
decisions.condition: When evaluating or booking a hotel.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize hotels with free breakfast when available, and verify whether breakfast is included if the listing is unclear.
decisions.exception_condition: Do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely because free breakfast is unavailable unless the user makes it mandatory for the current booking; do not infer requirements about breakfast type or quality.
decisions.name: prefer_included_hotel_breakfast
decisions.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
decisions.rationale: Repeated hotel-selection evidence supports a longitudinal preference for included breakfast. The mixed phrasing warrants retaining the calibrated soft default without strengthening it into a universal requirement.

decisions.boundary_condition: Do not infer that the pool or hot tub must be indoor or outdoor; the indoor preference appears in only one dialogue. Do not treat unrelated one-off trip details such as destination, dates, price, or beach proximity as part of this habit.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness or exercise facility.
decisions.condition: When choosing or evaluating a hotel for a leisure stay.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or ask about hotels that offer the full pool-plus-hot-tub-plus-fitness/exercise amenity bundle, and call out clearly if one element is missing.
decisions.exception_condition: If otherwise suitable hotels do not offer all three amenities, present close matches while explicitly noting which of pool, hot tub, or fitness/exercise facility is absent.
decisions.name: hotel_recreation_and_exercise_amenities
decisions.preference_value: Prefers hotels with a pool, hot tub, and fitness/exercise facility.
decisions.rationale: Multiple dialogues consistently support a reusable hotel amenity-bundle preference. It is distinct from the breakfast preference, and the supplied fallback appropriately preserves usefulness when no hotel offers the full bundle.
